title: Pytorch fails to build with newer protobuf
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

I am trying to build Pytorch 2.1.2 with protobuf v4.25.8. It fails to build with the following error:

```
_/include/google/protobuf/repeated_field.h:127:52: error: static assertion failed: We only support non-string scalars in RepeatedField.
  127 |                           is_proto_enum<Element>>::value,

```



### Versions

Pytorch: 2.1.2
Protobuf: 4.25.8

cc @justinchuby @titaiwangms @malfet @seemethere
